author: BmB
body: I know that our team and others would certainly appreciate the team ts rooms back, we really enjoyed it and used it as our place to meet up and often organise scrims, it was one of the few ways competitive AV worked and i'm sure it doesn't take any effort for you guys to set it up. Maybe if a team request a room they can have one so that only teams who are active their can have a room? But please add the ts rooms back, they were great.
